title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork and Tofu
description: A flavorful and refreshing Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring grilled pork and tofu served with crispy bun.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, and chili sauce to make the Vietnamese-style pork marinade.
Add the marinade to the pork loin and let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Meanwhile, grill the tofu for 3-5 minutes per side or until it is golden brown.
Slice the grilled pork and tofu into thin strips.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading hoisin sauce on the bun, followed by the grilled pork, tofu, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Cook the crunchy bun according to package instructions.
Cut the crispy bun into bite-sized pieces.
Add the crunchy bun to the banh mi for extra texture.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
